title: 文化与社会精选 · 36 句
description: 围绕本主题的具体情境组织表达；覆盖请求、说明、比较与复合句，并附逐题用法。

items.zh: 这座博物馆不仅展出文物，也讲述普通居民的生活故事。
items.en: This museum not only displays historical objects but also tells the stories of ordinary residents.
answers: This museum not only displays historical objects but also tells the stories of ordinary residents.
items.notes: not only displays ... but also tells ... 并列两个谓语；普通人的生活也可以成为文化展示的内容。

items.zh: 虽然我听不懂歌词，仍然能感受到这首歌的情绪。
items.en: Although I can't understand the lyrics, I can still sense the emotion in the song.
answers: Although I can't understand the lyrics, I can still sense the emotion in the song.
Although I cannot understand the lyrics, I can still sense the emotion in the song.
items.notes: although 表示让步；lyrics 指歌词，通常用复数。

items.zh: 不同地区对同一个节日可能有不同的庆祝方式。
items.en: The same festival may be celebrated differently in different regions.
answers: The same festival may be celebrated differently in different regions.
items.notes: 情态被动语态聚焦节日；may 避免把差异概括为必然。

items.zh: 与其把习俗视为固定不变的规则，不如看看它如何随着生活改变。
items.en: Rather than treat a custom as a fixed rule, consider how it changes with everyday life.
answers: Rather than treat a custom as a fixed rule, consider how it changes with everyday life.
items.notes: treat A as B 表示把 A 看作 B；how 从句引导观察角度。

items.zh: 如果一门地方语言不再被孩子使用，它的未来就可能受到威胁。
items.en: If children stop using a local language, its future may be at risk.
answers: If children stop using a local language, its future may be at risk.
items.notes: stop doing 表示停止做；be at risk 表示面临风险。

items.zh: 让我印象最深的，是演员如何通过动作而不是台词表达悲伤。
items.en: What impressed me most was how the actor conveyed sadness through movement rather than dialogue.
answers: What impressed me most was how the actor conveyed sadness through movement rather than dialogue.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；convey emotion 表示传达情绪，rather than 比较表达手段。

items.zh: 这张老照片让祖母想起了她小时候住过的街道。
items.en: This old photograph reminded my grandmother of the street where she lived as a child.
answers: This old photograph reminded my grandmother of the street where she lived as a child.
items.notes: remind sb of sth；where 引导地点定语从句，修饰 street。

items.zh: 由于门票太贵，一些当地居民很少参观自己城市的文化场馆。
items.en: Because admission is too expensive, some local residents rarely visit cultural venues in their own city.
answers: Because admission is too expensive, some local residents rarely visit cultural venues in their own city.
items.notes: admission 指入场费；rarely 表示很少，不能再与 don't 连用。

items.zh: 游客拍照之前，应该先确认这个仪式是否允许拍摄。
items.en: Before taking photographs, visitors should check whether photography is permitted during the ceremony.
answers: Before taking photographs, visitors should check whether photography is permitted during the ceremony.
items.notes: before taking 的逻辑主语是 visitors；whether 引出需要确认的问题。

items.zh: 即使翻译准确，笑话中的文化背景也可能难以传达。
items.en: Even if a translation is accurate, the cultural context of a joke may be difficult to convey.
answers: Even if a translation is accurate, the cultural context of a joke may be difficult to convey.
items.notes: even if 引出让步；cultural context 指文化背景。

items.zh: 你认为这部改编电影保留了原著最重要的部分吗？
items.en: Do you think this film adaptation preserves the most important parts of the original book?
answers: Do you think this film adaptation preserves the most important parts of the original book?
items.notes: adaptation 表示改编作品；preserve 在此表示保留。

items.zh: 社区邀请老手艺人来教年轻人制作传统乐器。
items.en: The community invited experienced craftspeople to teach young people how to make traditional instruments.
answers: The community invited experienced craftspeople to teach young people how to make traditional instruments.
items.notes: invite sb to do；teach sb how to do，具体描述文化传承活动。

items.zh: 展览按照年代排列，让人能看到风格如何变化。
items.en: The exhibition is arranged chronologically, showing how styles changed.
answers: The exhibition is arranged chronologically, showing how styles changed.
items.notes: chronologically：按时间顺序。

items.zh: 这件作品的说明牌有两种语言。
items.en: The label for this artwork is in two languages.
answers: The label for this artwork is in two languages.
items.notes: label 在展览中指说明牌。

items.zh: 我想知道这座雕像原来放在哪里。
items.en: I would like to know where this statue originally stood.
answers: I would like to know where this statue originally stood.
I'd like to know where this statue originally stood.
items.notes: stood 表示原本坐落于某处。

items.zh: 这段口述历史记录了工厂关闭后的社区变化。
items.en: This oral history records changes in the community after the factory closed.
answers: This oral history records changes in the community after the factory closed.
items.notes: oral history：口述历史。

items.zh: 演出结束后，观众有机会向导演提问。
items.en: After the performance, the audience had a chance to ask the director questions.
answers: After the performance, the audience had a chance to ask the director questions.
items.notes: ask sb questions：向某人提问。

items.zh: 尽管舞台布景简单，灯光让场景显得很有层次。
items.en: Although the set was simple, the lighting gave the scene a sense of depth.
answers: Although the set was simple, the lighting gave the scene a sense of depth.
items.notes: a sense of depth：层次感、纵深感。

items.zh: 这首歌的旋律让我想起家乡的节日。
items.en: The melody reminds me of festivals in my hometown.
answers: The melody reminds me of festivals in my hometown.
items.notes: remind sb of：使人想起。

items.zh: 翻译保留了大意，却没有完全传达原文的幽默。
items.en: The translation preserves the main meaning but does not fully convey the humour of the original.
answers: The translation preserves the main meaning but does not fully convey the humour of the original.
The translation preserves the main meaning but doesn't fully convey the humour of the original.
items.notes: convey humour：传达幽默。

items.zh: 我更喜欢能让人物说话方式各不相同的小说。
items.en: I prefer novels in which the characters have distinct ways of speaking.
answers: I prefer novels in which the characters have distinct ways of speaking.
items.notes: in which 引导定语从句。

items.zh: 我们能先讨论作品本身，再谈作者的名气吗？
items.en: Could we discuss the work itself before talking about the author's fame?
answers: Could we discuss the work itself before talking about the author's fame?
items.notes: itself 强调作品本身。

items.zh: 这个纪录片包含了几个彼此不同的视角。
items.en: The documentary includes several contrasting perspectives.
answers: The documentary includes several contrasting perspectives.
items.notes: contrasting：相互不同或形成对照的。

items.zh: 我不确定字幕是否准确地表达了那句话的语气。
items.en: I am not sure whether the subtitles capture the tone of that line accurately.
answers: I am not sure whether the subtitles capture the tone of that line accurately.
I'm not sure whether the subtitles capture the tone of that line accurately.
items.notes: capture the tone：传达语气。

items.zh: 参观者可以触摸复制品，但不能触摸原件。
items.en: Visitors may touch the replicas but not the originals.
answers: Visitors may touch the replicas but not the originals.
items.notes: replica：复制品。

items.zh: 这条老街修复后，仍然有一些原来的店主留在这里。
items.en: Some original shopkeepers remain on this street following its restoration.
answers: Some original shopkeepers remain on this street following its restoration.
items.notes: following 在此表示在……之后。

items.zh: 社区正在征集老照片，为下个月的展览做准备。
items.en: The community is collecting old photographs for next month's exhibition.
answers: The community is collecting old photographs for next month's exhibition.
items.notes: collect：征集、收集。

items.zh: 我想向长辈了解这个习俗小时候是什么样的。
items.en: I want to ask older relatives what this custom was like in their childhood.
answers: I want to ask older relatives what this custom was like in their childhood.
items.notes: what ... was like：过去是什么样。

items.zh: 如果你不熟悉餐桌礼仪，可以先观察主人怎么做。
items.en: If you are unfamiliar with table manners, you can first observe what the host does.
answers: If you are unfamiliar with table manners, you can first observe what the host does.
items.notes: be unfamiliar with：不熟悉。

items.zh: 这里人们通常提前多久到达社交聚会？
items.en: How early do people usually arrive for social gatherings here?
answers: How early do people usually arrive for social gatherings here?
items.notes: how early：提前多久。

items.zh: 我不想因为一个人的行为，就对整个群体下判断。
items.en: I do not want to judge a whole group by one person's behaviour.
answers: I do not want to judge a whole group by one person's behaviour.
I don't want to judge a whole group by one person's behaviour.
items.notes: judge A by B：依据 B 判断 A。

items.zh: 这份报纸把评论与新闻报道放在不同的栏目里。
items.en: This newspaper separates opinion pieces from news reports in different sections.
answers: This newspaper separates opinion pieces from news reports in different sections.
items.notes: opinion piece：评论文章。

items.zh: 标题听起来很确定，但正文用了许多表示可能性的词。
items.en: The headline sounds certain, but the article uses many words expressing possibility.
answers: The headline sounds certain, but the article uses many words expressing possibility.
items.notes: expressing 为分词定语。

items.zh: 志愿者为第一次来的观众解释活动流程。
items.en: Volunteers explain the programme to first-time visitors.
answers: Volunteers explain the programme to first-time visitors.
items.notes: explain sth to sb。

items.zh: 票价包含导览，还是需要另买一张票？
items.en: Does admission include a guided tour, or do I need a separate ticket?
answers: Does admission include a guided tour, or do I need a separate ticket?
items.notes: admission：入场费用。

items.zh: 让我喜欢这个社区的，是不同背景的人都能参与活动。
items.en: What I like about this community is that people from different backgrounds can join its activities.
answers: What I like about this community is that people from different backgrounds can join its activities.
items.notes: what 从句作主语。
